msg: Hello, I'm an Advanced Open Water diver from Denmark, staying in Getsemaní for a week in March. I'd like to do the Nitrox specialty with you and also some regular fun dives. How does it work and what would it cost?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

That sounds like a great plan! The Nitrox specialty is a one-day course with online theory and two instructor-supervised dives in the Rosario Islands. It includes the boat transfer from Cartagena, equipment, lunch, and PADI certification. You’ll complete the readings and knowledge reviews before the dives. The meeting point is Muelle de la Bodeguita at 8:00 a.m., with an estimated return to Cartagena around 4:15 p.m.

Your Advanced Open Water certification meets the certification requirement for the specialty. You can book the specialty here: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/nitrox-specialty/17?language=en

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• PADI Specialty: Nitrox: 418 USD · 464 USD

For regular fun dives, the Cartagena option is a one-day trip with two dives, round-trip boat transfer, lunch, and equipment. Would you like to do one day of fun diving, or are you considering multiple days?

msg: One day of fun diving would be great, the day after the Nitrox course. I'm going alone. My last dive was in August.
reply:
Perfect! 🙌

🤿 *Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day)*
💰 *178 USD* per person (online rate)
✅ Includes: National Park entrance fee, mandatory dive insurance, speedboat transport Cartagena-Islands-Cartagena, 2 guided dives with a certified PADI professional, diving equipment, lunch and eco-social contribution to DIVE TO HEAL.
📍 Departure from Cartagena (Muelle de la Bodeguita, 8:00 a.m.).

👉 *For more information and to book, click here:*
https://book.divingplanet.org/book/salidas-de-buceo/1?language=en

Is there anything else I can help you with? I can *add another activity*, answer questions, or adjust your booking. 🤿

msg: Thanks! For the Nitrox course, do I need to do anything before the day? And can I do both on consecutive days without a problem for flying on the 20th?
reply:
Yes—you can do the Nitrox specialty and fun dives on consecutive days. For the Nitrox course, you’ll need a PADI Open Water Diver certification, and after registering you’ll receive a digital introduction. Please complete the readings and knowledge reviews before the practical dives. You’ll also need to show your certified diver card on the day or send a photo beforehand.

The course medical form is required: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol (it’s in Spanish). The insurance form is sent in your booking confirmation email. Bring a swimsuit, towel, sunscreen, sunglasses, and comfortable clothes.

You'll also need:
• Minimum age: 10 and over.
• For recreational dive outings, the refresher and the courses for already-certified divers (Advanced, Rescue, Divemaster and specialties), you must present your certified diver card. You can send us a photo of it beforehand or show it on the day of the activity.

For flying, wait at least 18 hours after your last dive. The interval is counted from the last dive—not from when you return to Cartagena. So if your final dive is on the day before your flight on the 20th, the exact timing matters; what time is your flight, and which date would your last dive be?

🤿 *PADI Specialty: Nitrox*
💰 *418 USD* per person (online rate)
📚 PADI course: dates, sessions and details are arranged with you.

👉 *For more information and to book, click here:*
https://book.divingplanet.org/book/nitrox-specialty/17?language=en
